audience: contract administrators and sales ops staff who send documents for e-signature with Documenso

useCases.title: Find documents that still wait for a signature
useCases.text: The AI lists documents by status, folder, template or a text query and opens each one. You get the documents that are not signed yet, with their current status.

useCases.title: Check who has signed a document and who has not
useCases.text: The AI reads a document with its recipients, fields and status, and a single recipient with email, role, signing order and signed state.

useCases.title: Create a document from a template and send it
useCases.text: The AI reads a template to find its recipient placeholders, creates a new document with the real recipients and can send it for signature at once.

useCases.title: Resend the signing invitation to recipients
useCases.text: The AI finds a sent document and resends the invitation to the recipients you name. This emails real people.

useCases.title: Add a signer to a draft and send it
useCases.text: The AI adds a signer, approver, viewer or CC to a draft document and then sends the draft to its recipients for signature.

useCases.title: Get the PDF link and attachments of a document
useCases.text: The AI gets a download link for a document's PDF (a link, not the file) and lists the attachments on the document.
